family_title: Production Strategy B - EMA-crossover walk-forward momentum (long/short) full backtest

operator_decision.decided_by: operator (Hanqin-ge), relayed by ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol) card t_ad2e119e
operator_decision.text: Stop Strategy B immediately: the full-backtest semantics require the DCA parameter domain and the cohort-level survivor disposition before any further production. Preserve all B evidence; do not continue calculation and do not issue a scientific verdict.
operator_decision.reason: Contract v1.3.0 changes two semantic layers of a full backtest: the DCA parameter domain (a single PROVISIONAL rail is no longer a full backtest) and the family gate (per-cohort survivor evidence replaces cross-cohort median gates). A Strategy B round run under v1.2.0 semantics cannot be finished into a v1.3.0 verdict without changing what was pre-registered, which INV-4 forbids.

verdict.explanation: No PASS and no REJECT exists for Strategy B. Its only terminal records are one technical FAILED attempt and one operator-stopped INCOMPLETE attempt. Nothing in this record may be cited as a performance statement about the EMA-crossover hypothesis.

attempts.summary: engine defect in the B runner (fee not deducted from realised equity; entry_delay_1_bar lag dead). Fixed inside the same round, new run_id.
attempts.script_recoverability_note: the pre-fix script bytes were never committed to the repo and no copy survives on the host (measured 2026-09-13: only sha256:f10a64cd... exists in the repo, in the host /scripts deploy directory, and in the u2 run-spec). The u1 FAILED sentinel therefore documents a technical failure whose script cannot be recomputed; it is not a scientific record and is not re-run (INV-15).

attempts.summary: all phases had completed (state.json stage=ARTIFACT_READY, result.json + artifacts/ present), but no terminal sentinel had been published when the operator stopped the round. The host-side INCOMPLETE sentinel makes the attempt terminal so it can never be re-run (INV-15) and keeps the computed artifact an operator-stopped record rather than a verdict.

not_kept: no verdict.json (none was ever written for this round)

repo_disposition_of_uncommitted_b_files.decision: commit, not delete: they are the only surviving record of what was launched and how. They carry no verdict, and the B card is not a production path any more (superseded by contract v1.3.0 semantics).
repo_disposition_of_uncommitted_b_files.evidence_redaction: The launch record and the two preflight snapshots were produced by the B worker and contained host-specific absolute paths and a PID. Per evidence/README rule 1-2 they were redacted before commit: user-home paths and /tmp launch logs -> <PLACEHOLDER>, host_bg_pid -> null. Nothing else was modified (JSON fields, statuses and checksums are byte-identical otherwise). The bare mount point string '/Volumes/ExpansionDrive' is kept because contract section 3 already publishes that mount path; this matches the evidence snapshots committed for Strategy A.

archive_relocation.reason: audit t_246c62d7 finding M1 (card t_6c83c9fb): the operator-stopped runner and its engine test were still directly runnable from the active runtime path (repo container/scripts/ and the host /scripts deploy directory). That contradicts the README description of container/scripts/ as the canonical current runtime and makes an operator-stopped implementation look like a live production one. The two files were relocated byte-identically to an explicitly archive-only evidence path.
archive_relocation.archive_is_not_a_runtime_path: the archived test still defaults to /scripts/30_strategy_b_run.py and the archived runner still writes under /result*; both are kept byte-identical as evidence only. They are NOT a deploy source, are not mounted into qlib-run and must not be executed against the live runtime.
archive_relocation.unchanged: /results was not touched: family.json, round-spec.json, the attempt artifacts and the FAILED/INCOMPLETE sentinels are byte-identical; no verdict.json exists and none was written.

sha256_repo_vs_host_deploy.note: the archived sha is exactly the one pinned by the u2 run-spec, so the surviving script is the script that produced the preserved artifacts. The host deploy copy was removed by the M1 relocation (card t_6c83c9fb) and the repo copy moved to the archive path, so there is no active-copy sha to compare any more.
